evidence.appropriate: a figure sitting on a double rule is the bookkeeper's sign of a finished total; plain and level, Everyman with Sage, no caption needed by anyone who has kept books
evidence.distinctive: no competitor among FreeAgent, Xero, QuickBooks, Coconut, Pandle uses rules or a total; but the block-on-bars silhouette sits near generic card and screen icons
evidence.simple: three rectangles, 16 anchors; drawable in seconds
evidence.legible: the favicon keeps block and one rule apart at 16 px (thinnest 2.72 px); the wordmark passes 7 px x-height at 120 px
evidence.adaptable: identical in black, white on black and one colour; small and favicon tiers redrawn with thicker rules
evidence.timeless: no trend shape; rectangles and rules would have read the same ten years ago
evidence.universal: mirrored panel identical; rotated 90 reads as a card with stripes, a faint secondary reading
evidence.clear: description search (rectangle over a double rule, total underline logo) found no matching mark; nearest are generic UI icons
evidence.congruent: level, symmetric, low complexity, medium weight, framed by its own rules; a little heavier and squarer than the light, open name sound asks
evidence.system: horizontal, stacked, symbol, compact, small and favicon all build without tier warnings; rationale draft in critique.md
